title: Permissions
intro: Inspect and manage project and pseudonym-domain permissions for the selected project.
searchHelp: Search for a user and adjust only the permissions you are allowed to delegate.
selectProjectFirst: Select a project first to manage project and pseudonym-domain permissions.

scope.selectScope: Project, entity type, or pseudonym domain
scope.selectDescription: Select the project, an entity type, a project-associated pseudonym domain, or a domain that is not assigned to any project. Use the search field in the dropdown to filter the list.
scope.searchPlaceholder: Search project, entity type, or pseudonym domain

empty.noPermissionsForUser: No permissions found for this user.
empty.noExplicitPermissions: No explicit TrustDeck permissions were found for this account.
empty.noTokenRoles: No roles were present in the current access token.
empty.noGrantedInScope: No rights are currently granted in this section.
empty.noMissingInScope: All rights in this section are currently granted.
empty.noProjectOrGroupRows: No project, project-associated pseudonym-domain, or unassigned pseudonym-domain permission definitions are available.
empty.missingRightsUnavailable: Permission definitions are currently unavailable, so only granted rights can be shown. Missing rights cannot be calculated yet.
empty.missingRightsUnavailableShort: Missing rights cannot be calculated until permission definitions are available.
empty.noProjectOrGroupRowsAll: No project or pseudonym-domain permission definitions are available.
empty.noProjectRows: No project-specific permission definitions are available.
empty.noGroupRows: No pseudonym-domain permission definitions are available.
empty.noRightsInScope: You do not currently hold any rights in this scope.
empty.noManageableRights: There are no rights in this scope that you are allowed to grant or revoke.

errors.effectiveForbidden: Your current account is not allowed to read effective TrustDeck permissions from the backend.
errors.effectiveError: Effective TrustDeck permissions could not be loaded.
errors.definitionsForbidden: Permission definitions are currently not available because you do not have the necessary role to view and/or edit permissions.
errors.retryExplanation: Refresh the access token and retry if your permissions were changed recently.
errors.definitionsError: Permission definitions could not be loaded. Please check the backend logs or try again later.
errors.usingHeldRightsOnly: The complete permission catalogue is not available. Only rights you currently hold are shown and can be delegated.
errors.selectedUserPermissions: The selected user’s permissions could not be loaded for this scope.

toast.permissionsRefreshedDetail: The access token was refreshed and permission definitions were loaded.
toast.noDefinitionsLoadedDetail: The access token was refreshed, but the backend still did not return permission definitions.
toast.retryFailedDetail: The token refresh or permission lookup failed. Please try again or check your backend role mapping.
toast.searchFailedDetail: Users could not be loaded. Please check your permission-management access.
toast.updateFailedDetail: Failed to update permissions. The backend may have rejected this operation.

assignmentNote: Permissions are assigned for one project or pseudonym domain at a time. You can only grant rights that you already hold yourself; privilege escalation is not permitted.
projectDomainIntro: Inspect your project and pseudonym-domain rights and assign rights you already hold to other users.
globalBoxSubtitle: Inspect and manage global rights that apply across TrustDeck.
globalSearchHelp: Search for a user and grant or revoke global rights that you already hold yourself.
projectDomainSearchHelp: First select a project or pseudonym domain above. Then search for a user below to grant or revoke the rights you hold for that scope.
userSearchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or user ID
userSearchRestrictedFallback: User search requires a global permission. You can still enter an exact Keycloak user ID and use it directly.
viewModeHint: Permissions are shown read-only. Select Edit permissions to make changes.
editModeHint: Select a permission card to switch it between granted and not granted. Changes are applied only after saving.
